messages_orig.content:
please check the following and produce a structured note : 34-year-old female with recurrent sneezing and watery eyes triggered by cat dander.

she had a skin prick test showing strong positive for cat dander and moderate positive for dust mites

advised to avoid direct cat contact, use dust-mite covers on bedding, and start daily antihistamine

next follow-up in 4 weeks if no improvement
